content_md: The consumer equivalent of f*ear and glee index* is *knowing and gooning index* where consumers oscillate between voraciously consuming information about products and harboring desires that are never really satisfied. Sports betting for example is satisfying now more than in Victorian England because now you presumably have enough data on the players and games as much as coaches themselves so you can attempt to relive Moneyball. Women's skincare is another example where most consumers are as well read as the CEO of Sephora, and all skincare products are chasing some kind of "holy grail" of skincare, which also shifts beauty standards. The most successful products in this era provide a constant oscillation between having the knowledge and chasing a desire that never fully get realized.
